name: RAOfflineProxy
summary: Provides an offline RetroAchievements proxy for supported emulators.

notes: Review on 2026-10-20 verified the Knulli v2.2.0-alpha1 shell asset against the GitHub digest: 1377625 bytes, SHA-256 94d1d2de7d213300463dc6e4f4fd28ce9ba25344e3b2fe9c7371f7b4f9a06f0b. No installer was executed.

No separate publisher checksum was published for 2.2.0-alpha1. The calculated download hash matched the GitHub release asset API digest. The upstream-managed experimental exception trusts the publisher's GitHub account and GitHub, not independent publisher authentication. Installation remains pinned to the reviewed hash and size; it never fetches a new expected digest.

Rechecked 2.2.0-alpha1 on 2026-10-24: data-only decoding at byte offset 1173 after the unique __RAOFFLINEPROXY_PAYLOAD_BELOW__ marker yielded a 1018930-byte tar.gz with 66 regular files, 9 directories, and 2340621 regular-file bytes. No duplicate paths, traversal, absolute paths, or special-file entries were found. Store base64_offset support removes the need for a separately published archive; it never executes the shell prefix.

Authorized upstream-managed experimental installation: the Store only verifies and extracts the bundle, maps launchers into bin, and creates a Tools entry. It does not run the installer or configure the proxy. Launch the app to set up emulator integration and optional autostart. Runtime writes and upstream updates are not sandboxed or checksum-controlled by the Store.

Stop the proxy, disable autostart, then run bin/raofflineproxy remove-boot-hook before Store removal. Read-only removal checks reject remaining boot/game hooks, a service PID file, or the default proxy address in known emulator/frontend configs. Saved patch state is retained because upstream Stop may leave it after restoring emulator settings. The Store never removes shared hooks or persistent config/cache data. Do not use upstream Uninstall if you need cached credentials or queued awards; it deletes them. Custom proxy addresses and configuration paths require manual review.

Historical 2.2.0-alpha1 review: both bundled native libraries are ELF64 AArch64 with a glibc 2.17 symbol floor. The SQLite extension targets CPython 3.12. Python 3.12 and pygame must already be present; no runtime is installed by the Store. The owner confirmed 2.2.0-alpha1 tested on TrimUI Smart Pro, Knulli, aarch64, 1280x720 on 2026-10-25. This is not a 2.3.0-alpha1 device report; other device matrices remain untested.

Review on 2026-10-29 independently verified the v2.3.0-alpha1 Knulli shell asset against GitHub asset 679594367: 1466921 bytes, SHA-256 90bc7bf59def667a864a569315010532224968eb4ec475999cb2ffcf6aeb487a. No separate publisher checksum is published for this asset. The shell prefix was not executed; its unique payload marker still ends at byte offset 1173. Data-only decoding yielded a 1085033-byte tar.gz with 88 regular files, 10 directories and 2575572 regular-file bytes, without duplicates, unsafe paths, links or special entries.

The 2.3.0-alpha1 launchers and install/uninstall scripts match 2.2.0-alpha1 byte for byte. All 67 packaged app Python files match tagged source d86bcb2b66dbeab56792f1f374ee273f4f9063c6. Both native libraries remain ELF64 AArch64 requiring libc/libpthread and GLIBC_2.17; bundled SQLite still targets CPython 3.12. Python 3.12 and pygame remain required. Device testing and real account/cache migration are not established by static inspection or Store lifecycle fixtures. See docs/raofflineproxy-2.3.0-alpha1.md for release evidence and review limits.

New runtime review: single-ROM ZIP hashing streams unbounded decompressed content into temporary rom-hash-* directories beside the persistent config/database under /userdata/system/.config/raofflineproxy; ensure sufficient free space and retain cached credentials/queued awards. Knulli authentication can now read RetroAchievements credentials from knulli.conf or batocera.conf before a RetroArch config exists. Optional PCSX2 integration accepts a custom INI on Linux; do not change its configured path before Stop, because upstream restoration redetects the current path rather than using the captured original. Manually restore custom emulator/proxy paths before removal. No default Knulli PCSX2 path or dependency is assumed.

Removal review retains the boot/game-hook, PID and default-address checks and adds the fourth documented Knulli RetroArch config candidate, /userdata/system/.config/retroarch/retroarchcustom.cfg. These are read-only checks, not runtime confinement or automatic cleanup. Runtime updaters and upstream Uninstall remain outside Store integrity and preservation guarantees.

evidence.note: Historical 2026-10-25 owner confirmation covers RAOfflineProxy 2.2.0-alpha1 on TrimUI Smart Pro only, not 2.3.0-alpha1. Separate lifecycle steps were not reported.
Downloaded Knulli shell asset matches the GitHub API size and SHA-256. Embedded archive was read as data only; extraction safety does not establish runtime safety or device compatibility.

Knulli asset digest sha256:94d1d2de7d213300463dc6e4f4fd28ce9ba25344e3b2fe9c7371f7b4f9a06f0b matches the calculated download hash; size 1377625. GitHub-hosted integrity evidence only, with no separate publisher checksum or independent publisher authentication.

Packaged download_knulli_update_installer writes a downloaded executable without an expected checksum. Packaged menu_sdl.py invokes installation; platform.py writes a boot hook and accepts configured startup paths.
Knulli embedded payload inspected as data only. The release is not GitHub-immutable; the Store pins exact bytes rather than trusting replacement assets.

Independently downloaded 1466921 bytes match GitHub SHA-256 90bc7bf59def667a864a569315010532224968eb4ec475999cb2ffcf6aeb487a. No separate publisher checksum for the Knulli asset; GitHub-hosted integrity only. Payload offset 1173; 2575572 regular-file bytes.

Packaged Python matches this tag. ELF inspection retains AArch64, glibc 2.17, libc/libpthread and CPython 3.12 SQLite requirements. Launchers, install/uninstall scripts and Store file mappings are unchanged. No upstream executable, script or Python module was run.

ZIP hashing writes temporary decompressed ROM content beside the persistent database without a local extracted-size/free-space cap. config.py lists four Knulli RetroArch config candidates; pcsx2_cfg.py can patch a custom INI on Linux, and its restoration does not use the saved original path. auth.py reads frontend credentials. The unchanged Knulli updater still executes an unverified downloaded installer; experimental upstream-managed warnings remain required.

install.warning: Untested; GitHub digest only, no publisher checksum. Runtime writes/updates are not sandboxed. ZIP hashing needs free userdata space. Close app before Store operations; Repair restores pinned code. Before removal: stop proxy, disable autostart, run bin/raofflineproxy remove-boot-hook. Config and awards stay; upstream Uninstall deletes them. Restore custom emulator/PCSX2 paths manually; keep those paths unchanged until Stop.

menu.name: RAOfflineProxy
menu.description: Offline casual RetroAchievements. Launch to configure; stop proxy and disable autostart before Store removal.

uninstall_checks.message: Stop proxy, disable autostart, then run /userdata/system/raofflineproxy/bin/raofflineproxy remove-boot-hook before retrying. Shared boot files are never edited by the Store.
Remove the RAOfflineProxy game hook through the app before retrying.
Stop RAOfflineProxy before retrying. The Store never stops or kills the proxy.
Stop the proxy and restore emulator settings through RAOfflineProxy before retrying. Keep your config/cache directory.
Restore the default proxy redirect in batocera.conf through RAOfflineProxy before retrying.
Stop the proxy and restore RetroArch settings through RAOfflineProxy before retrying.
Restore the default proxy redirect in retroarch.cfg through RAOfflineProxy before retrying.
Restore the default proxy redirect in .config/retroarch/retroarchcustom.cfg through RAOfflineProxy before retrying.
Restore the default proxy redirect in .config/retroarch/retroarch.cfg through RAOfflineProxy before retrying.
